mission: Open Duck reduced MJX model probe
interpretation: Single raw MJX step passes on GPU, CPU scanned substeps pass, but GPU scanned substeps timeout or fail with ROCM_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS.
conclusion: The local 7900 XTX ROCm blocker is narrowed to JAX/ROCm execution of the lax.scan substep path around mjx.step, not MJCF compile, a single raw MJX step, or foot contact alone.
safety: No robot tests, SSH, deployment, runtime behavior changes, policy changes, or training were run.
